item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 03/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over Guangdong today. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A southwesterly airstream is expected to bring showers to the coast of southern China towards the weekend and early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will linger over the East China Sea in the next couple of days. It may turn towards the seas south of Japan afterwards. Meanwhile, the area of low pressure over Beibu Wan will bring unsettled weather to the region.
